Select IC50 activity records for human KCNJ2 (CHEMBL240) with compound structures and literature provenance. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures (inner join), activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Filter by target CHEMBL240, standard_type IC50, and non-null canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
